item.title: SHIELD Digital Twin Project
item.description:
The SHIELD Digital Twin project is developing a comprehensive framework for community-scale digital twins. Key aspects include:

  • Distributed edge computing framework for efficient network utilization
  • Progressive inference models for resource-constrained environments
  • Cross-institutional collaboration and team coordination
  • Real-time data processing and visualization capabilities

item.title: SHIELD: A Distributed Edge Computing Framework for Community-Scale Digital Twins
Wildfire Intelligence Projects
item.description:
Research focusing on advanced wildfire detection and prediction systems:

  • Generative model for wildfire spread prediction using Conditional Variational Autoencoders
  • Supervised compression system achieving 72.9% detection accuracy while reducing image size to 4.8KB
  • Edge computing framework for distributed wildfire detection using early-exit neural networks
  • Integration with existing wildfire monitoring infrastructure
